note: The manager owns this file. Structured on purpose: the previous loop kept its state as a prose header that degenerated into a run-on paragraph. Every dimension has a byte AND a count cap, enforced by rotate-ledger.mjs.

menu.note: The menu is DATA, not prose in a skill file, so the manager can extend it (ladder rung 3). Adding a domain or a kind here is a legitimate strategic move.

kinds.name: New element
kinds.what: a thing the town did not contain

kinds.name: New CA rule
kinds.what: a new per-cell rule that makes the grid evolve

kinds.name: Deepen
kinds.what: make an existing system richer, or wire two together

kinds.name: Connect
kinds.what: link two places or systems that ignore each other

kinds.name: Polish
kinds.what: make what is there read better; add nothing

kinds.name: Interaction/UX
kinds.what: how you read, poke or navigate the diorama

kinds.name: Scale/World
kinds.what: change the size, span or time of the world itself

kinds.name: Harness
kinds.what: the loop's own instruments — gates, probes, runlog, stats. Changes nothing a viewer sees, and does NOT count toward a domain's balance

coverage.note: domain -> kind -> iteration numbers. Pre-loop work (CHANGELOG iterations 1-31, hand-driven) is recorded as `pre` so the manager knows the ground it stands on.

skyxpolish.why: 6 polish entries, more than any other cell, on the best-drawn system in the town. The lowest-yield move available. Sky work from here is Deepen or Connect.

inventory.note: What the town ALREADY contains: nouns plus the symbols and probes a brief must name. One line per system, <=300 B (rotate-ledger.mjs enforces). Read before you build.
courtyard: walled garden — bed ring, four arches, benches, desire paths from wear[], daisies, ivy, a pre-dawn sweeper (a.broom), one linden; planting CA (11 species, bloom, seeding, crowding, dieback); drawGround cached, dirtied by wearDirty. probes/ground-rebuilds.mjs

the beds read the YEAR — growF()/dieF() off warmth, lawn health in groundCol; bloomCap() a RAMP over warmth (BLOOM_LO → BLOOM_HI = anchor), a CEILING dithered per cell/plot by capStep(). probes/beds-year.mjs, bloom-cap.mjs
snow knows the paths — snowAt() discounts by max(wear/SNOW_WEAR_AT, trod[]); trod[] cut by feet on GRASS and a.broom agents, buried by SNOW_BURY. probes/snow-wear.mjs
litter[] (Uint8 per cell): leaf litter laid by landing shed leaves, painted in drawGround (tint + hash scatter), cut by feet/broom, batch-decayed, cleared by snow. probes/litter-year.mjs
lane: kiosk, pavement cafe with claimable tables, awnings, washing lines (garments in on weatherComing() and at dusk), planters, lamps, benches; market every 4th day, three stalls, marketRaise(i) stages each on one 0..1
the working day hangs off the SUN — kioskOpen/marketOpen/marketClose/marketRaise/sweeper are offsets from sunUp/sunDown; MK_MIN_SPAN floors winter. probes/working-day.mjs

the stalls sell what the plots grew — produce[] written only by harvestPlot(); stockMarket() latches it into mkShelf per market day; marketRaise(i) gates on mkTrades(i): a thin year raises fewer stalls. probes/market-year.mjs

the ONE evening place — TAP_DOOR in the gatehouse front, tapOpen() sunDown-3..03.00, tapF() 0..1; callIn(a,pts,dur) the ONE re-route onto TAP_SLOTS priced by pathHours()/tapFits(); tapCallers() on market days. probes/evening-door.mjs

the NIGHT'S OWN ARRIVALS — spawnHomeAgent() rolls homeRate() while nightF > 0.3, a.homer outside laneCap/scarcity; homeDoor()/claimHome() the ONE pricing shared with goHome; HOME_DOORS 14. probes/home-arrivals.mjs, homer-shots.mjs

wet seats — seatRefused(a) = sky > SIT_REFUSE OR seatWet(a) (wetF() above 0.75 − a.wary·0.4); the street-stop site shares the predicate; arrivals only. probes/wet-seats.mjs (WET0=… pins wetness at a clear 10:00)
street: cross street with two footways, roadway, curbs, lamps, four street trees in pits (TREE_PITS, drawLaneTree); allotment block of 17 plots, timber fence, gates, shed, an alley through the block

harvest cycle — harvestPlot() lifts a mature 3x2 bed whole, bAge doubles as the fallow clock (only when !bSp), re-sown under plotCrop(); spawnAllotAgent() the allotments' own arrivals, rate on ripePlots(); gardeners leave with a basket (a.crop)

seasonal canopy on all 13 trees — leafOut/Fresh/Deep/Turn/Shed + leafCol() off seasonPhase, bare in winter behind drawBoughs(); leafFallF() drives falling leaves; fruit trees add blossomF()/fruitF(). probes/canopy-year.mjs

winter hardiness grain-matched to the PLOT — SPECIES.hardy:1 (cabbages), plotStands(x,y) off plotCrop(); seed() sows the block through speciesFor() so it is vegetables from t=0. probes/allot-year.mjs, allot-scatter.mjs

the allotments' WINTER — digWeather() (cold, dry, little snow) adds DIG_RATE to allotRate; fallowPlots() = stalled non-hardy plots; a.dig holder turnPlot()s them: turned[] cells dark, unsown until warmth returns. probes/allot-year.mjs
plaza: plaza with a fountain and a paved roundel, four tree pits, benches; quay benches. PAVING + pavingAt(x,y) the ONE predicate naming a cell's paving, each with a crumbs line and bird box; crumbSpot() keeps birds off the basin. probes/paving-places.mjs
spawnEastAgent() — the east quarter's own arrival source (eastCap/eastRate, a.east, eastOpen() on daylight); enters by alley, quay head or park gate, one stop, leaves the way it came

the FOUNTAIN reads the YEAR — fountainPlay() = 1 - FOUNT_SWING*greyF(): jets, reach, droplets; basin via riverCol() + fountainIce() below FOUNT_ICE; fountainStand() sets the bench/fountain split in both spawners. probes/fountain-year.mjs

wind on the plaza: windF() 0..1 beside isWindy(); fountain jets/droplets lean +x on windT with a lee spray drift, fountainStand() drops by FOUNT_WIND_SHY on windy days, bunting flutters. probes/fountain-wind.mjs
river: river, one rowboat, three-arch bridge (lays its own shadow), towpath, church with tower, nave and a rose window lit at night, bandstand, four orchard trees, jetty, park gate; pigeons flush off the belfry when the bell rings

byTheWater() the ONE predicate for river-facing places, boatWatch() its reader, a parapet stop (PARAPET_Y/Z); ONE fair-weather rowboat, boatRate()/boatSpeed() — PRESENCE. riverRun() drives drawRiverFlow(t), riverCol(). probes/river-year.mjs
the BANDSTAND has a summer concert — bandF() stages three BAND_PLAYERS and bunting on ONE 0..1; isBandDay() is hash(day,617) vs bandChance() off warmth. probes/bandstand-year.mjs

swans are a PAIR with states — s.state swim|upend|preen + s.hold; cob (swans[0]) picks the stretch, pen re-reads it every 2.5–5.5 s, 0.9-cell give-way; SWAN_UPEND/SWAN_PREEN/SWAN_BANK; drawSwan tilts on hold. probes/swan-pair.mjs

the NIGHT on the water — drawRiverLights(): bar columns under RIVER_LAMPS + a moon column, × nightF × (1 − cloudCover()); WIND on it (WIND_FLOW_*, WIND_CHOP, BOAT_WIND_SHY/SLOW), exact at windF 0; ONE a.nightRail stander. probes/river-night.mjs

the BOAT LANTERN — boatLampF() fades in on nightF 0.3..0.45; BOAT_LAMP set by drawBoat, relit after applyLight with its own halo; a bar column under the hull; boatRate() NOT thinned at night (65 % of dark samples). probes/boat-lantern.mjs
sky: day/night cycle (55 s day), sun and moon arc, backdrop hills, chimney smoke, a balloon; windowLit(sa,sb) — ONE predicate for pane and LIT[] glow, hours off the dusk edge (nid); facades CACHED; LIT_PANES/ROSE relit by a screen pass AFTER applyLight's multiply. probes/windows-night.mjs, polish-1x.mjs

cloudCover() — one slow rate-capped scalar; fronts build ~half a day, break after rain; weatherComing() the ramped predicate off it. rainFall 0..1 beside the raining boolean: drops, overcast tint, pond rings, sparkle, smoke

season() — the YEAR over SEASON_LEN 26 days, phase 0 midwinter, anchor SEASON_START 0.25 where every seasoned term equals the constant it replaced; greyF() drives the weather's year (fronts, spellLen). probes/weather-year.mjs
the ground reads the lid — shadowF() with shSpread()/shOffset(): cast shadows fade, widen and retract together, eight sites, blurred on the cached ground. probes/shadow-cover.mjs

snow — snowF() turns showers to flakes past greyF 0.55; snowCover 0..1 (rate-capped, snowAt per cell, trodden kinds take less) whitens cached ground/roofs/awnings, melts as warmth lifts; census clock.snow. probes/snow-year.mjs

the WIND — windF() 0..1 rate-capped by stepWind(); windTarget() = max(windyDay() day hash, frontWind()); frontWind() ramps on cloud 0.46→0.76, 0 while raining/frontSpent (latched at rain start). Magnitude only. probes/wind-front.mjs, wind-year.mjs

wetness 0..1 — wetF()/stepWet(): rain soaks paving, dries by daylight×warmth. Cached ground reads wetPainted via wetCol() on PATH/SIDE/ROAD; lane sheen 0.16×wetness; drawWetLights() lamp bars on WET_LAMPS × wetness × nightF. probes/wet-year.mjs, wet-shots.mjs
life: walkers with itineraries — courtyard, street and eastern stops; cafe sitters; market and kiosk browsers; dogs on leads; ducks, swans, butterflies, fireflies, birds, one night cat, falling leaves
clock strikes at nine and eighteen (strikeClock, bellUntil), the church bell answers, walkers look up (a.listen); greetPass — two passing within ~1 cell may stop and talk (a.greet, chatCool)

EVERY sitter reads the sky — SIT_REFUSE turns a seat down, skyLifts(a) gives one up off a.wary, umbrellas on their own band; a refused seat takes routeToExit(); a pair judges once (a.mate). probes/seats-out.mjs
__entities() carries role, act, watch and per-kind extras per person with a stable id — the seam a behaviour probe reads
yearBusy(ex) multiplies the DAYLIGHT term of capacity/laneCap/eastCap only; POP_FLOOR + scarcity lift the three arrival RATES only. probes/season-year.mjs

crowds with their OWN arrival source, outside eastCount/laneCount: concert (spawnConcertAgent), evening door (spawnTapAgent), homers (spawnHomeAgent, a.homer); goHome(a) sends a lane leaver to a HOME_DOOR after dusk, HOMES read by windowLit(). probes/going-home.mjs
sill: the SILL under the canvas — #plate, #daytime, #season, #ticker (ordered queue, TICK_DWELL 2.5 s, cap 2), #stats, #ctrl; hidden under 640px except during an invitation. A ResizeObserver on the frame — the sill BORROWS space with no resize event

two LAPSE buttons, one mechanism — beginLapse(span, say): #season skips a quarter (stepSkip/simSub/skipEase); #daytime → beginEvening() lands at sunDown+1 h / sunUp+0.5 h, solved at arrival (sunAt); 'clock' is an OFFER. probes/season-skip.mjs, evening-skip.mjs

the NAMING — what is under the pointer (a TAP on a phone) is named in the sill: beds, plots, places off pavingAt/WATERS, trees; the LIVING via livingAt()/personName(a); WINDOWS/DOORS via FACES[]/faceAt(), windowName() reads windowLit + windowHours/HOMES. probes/naming.mjs

THE DIORAMA IS CLICKABLE and says so once — answersTouch(x,y) is the ONE predicate read by cursor and handler: seeds, a daisy, crumbs, a coin, a pebble. Invitations are a QUEUE, OFFERS[]. probes/touch-hint.mjs

harness: runlog --regrade; Harness verdicts graded on commit+log; crashed-worker retry; filmstrip AT(day,hour), night preset, pops.mjs (POP = >3.5× a neighbour); DRY_RUN=1; probes/dusk-relight-where.mjs, ground-rebuilds.mjs, frame-cost.mjs

FOLLOWS a person — a tap holds a walker: followLine() on the sill via updateNaming (outranks pointer + ticker), drawFollowMark() ring on the feet, followLost() closes on despawn; OFFERS follow; __follow(). probes/follow.mjs

watch.note: The east half is fed by ONE spawnLaneAgent roll under one laneCap (peaks at 9). Anything out there competes for that budget — check whether your feature needs its own arrival source before concluding it is unused. Bands: market 0.24, kiosk 0.18, cafe 0.26, allotment 0.48, plaza 0.48, quay 0.53, green 0.58. spawnEastAgent adds eastCap (max 7); its arrivals RETRACE their route, so a wider cap means single file.

THE NIGHT IS ONE TAP AWAY AND UNDER-PEOPLED. The clock button lapses to this evening in ~2.4 s, so every night system is on a viewer's first minute — and the town they land in holds 6–9 agents after dark, under one homer a night. Night SUPPLY (its own arrival source, spawnTapAgent is the model — never a share of laneCap) is the visible gap; the night's drawing is not.

Observer tools are advertised through OFFERS[] only (seeds, follow, season, clock — four offers, TICK_DWELL 2.5 s each). A new one joins that queue; nothing gets a hint of its own. Order in OFFERS is the order a passive visitor hears them.
